name: D5 动画验证: 转换后播放 Mixamo Idle 动画 + 轨道匹配率断言
description: 打开 bone_converter demo → 加载 Tripo 模型（骨骼41）→ Tripo→Mixamo 转换（骨骼22）→ 加载 Mixamo Idle 动画 → 断言轨道匹配率 ≥80% 且绝对匹配数 matched/total ≥20（window.__ANIM_MATCH__）→ 播放动画 → 断言 __ANIM_PLAYING__ → evaluate 读 mixer.time 确认动画推进（非 T-pose）→ 截图（动画播放中姿态）→ 断言无 console 错误

blocks.code: (() => { var m = window.__ANIM_MATCH__; return m ? 'rate=' + m.rate.toFixed(3) + ' total=' + m.total + ' matched=' + m.matched + ' clip=' + m.clipName : 'NO_ANIM_MATCH'; })()

(() => { var b = window.__MODEL_BBOX__ && window.__MODEL_BBOX__(); if (!b) return 'NO_BBOX_BEFORE'; window.__BBOX_BEFORE__ = b; return 'bbox_before center=' + b.center.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(3)}).join(',') + ' size=' + b.size.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(3)}).join(','); })()
(() => { var m = window.__ANIM_MIXER__; if (!m) return 'NO_MIXER'; window.__ANIM_T0__ = m.time; return 't0=' + m.time.toFixed(3); })()
(() => { var m = window.__ANIM_MIXER__; return m ? 't1=' + m.time.toFixed(3) + ' advance=' + (m.time - (window.__ANIM_T0__ || 0)).toFixed(3) : 'NO_MIXER'; })()

(() => { var b = window.__MODEL_BBOX__ && window.__MODEL_BBOX__(); var s = window.__BONE_STATS__ && window.__BONE_STATS__(); var before = window.__BBOX_BEFORE__; if (!b) return 'NO_BBOX_DURING'; if (!before) return 'NO_BBOX_BEFORE'; var ok = true; var msgs = []; var c = b.center; var sz = b.size; var inView = Math.abs(c[0]) < 5 && Math.abs(c[1]) < 5 && Math.abs(c[2]) < 5; if (!inView) { ok = false; msgs.push('center_out=' + c.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(2)}).join(',')); } if (sz.some(function(v){ return !isFinite(v) || v === 0 || v > 10; })) { ok = false; msgs.push('size_bad=' + sz.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(2)}).join(',')); } if (s) { if (s.nanCount > 0) { ok = false; msgs.push('bone_nan=' + s.nanCount); } if (s.infCount > 0) { ok = false; msgs.push('bone_inf=' + s.infCount); } if (s.zeroScaleCount > 0) { ok = false; msgs.push('bone_zeroScale=' + s.zeroScaleCount); } } var moved = Math.max(Math.abs(c[0]-before.center[0]), Math.abs(c[1]-before.center[1]), Math.abs(c[2]-before.center[2])); if (moved > 3) { ok = false; msgs.push('moved=' + moved.toFixed(2)); } return ok ? 'VIS_OK' : 'VIS_FAIL ' + msgs.join('|'); })()
